scenarios.name: example-scenario
scenarios.description: Template for creating new data scenarios

_comments.name: Unique identifier for the data scenario (kebab-case)
_comments.description: Brief description of what data this scenario provides
_comments.command: Command to seed this scenario (run from project root)
_comments.estimatedTime: Estimated time to seed scenario in milliseconds
_comments.dependencies: Array of services required for seeding
_comments.cleanup: Command to clean up scenario data (optional)
_comments.parallel: Whether this scenario can be seeded in parallel
_comments.cacheable: Whether scenario data can be cached between runs
